description:
When Otto opens a PR for an implement_issue task, the current body is just `Closes #N`. Enrich it by asking Claude (via a short Anthropic API call) to generate a structured PR description from the agent run output.

The call should receive: the issue title, the issue body, and the agent's summary output (AgentRunResult.summary). Claude should return a markdown PR body with sections like:

- What was done (2-4 sentences)
- Key changes (bullet list of files/approach)
- Testing notes (if any)
- Closes #N (always last)

The Anthropic API call should use a small/fast model (Haiku), be fire-and-forget with a short timeout (e.g. 15s), and fall back to the plain `Closes #N` body if it fails or times out. This keeps PR creation non-blocking even when the API is slow.

createPrForIssueTask (src/github/pulls.ts) should accept an optional `agentSummary` field. When provided, it passes it plus the issue details to a new `generatePrBody(input)` helper that calls the Anthropic API. The helper lives in src/github/pr-body.ts and is independently testable.
title: AI-generated PR body summarizing agent work
